label: coach_paldea_friend_first_01
text: I came as quickly as I could—like I’d do any less\nfor my best friend in the whole world![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

text: To be honest, I sorta just came ’cause it was you\nwho called and all, but...man, look at this place!\r\nBlueberry Academy is something else![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
